# IDCAStrategyManagerEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/events/arks/IDCAStrategyManagerEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IDCAStrategyManagerEvents

Events emitted by the DCA (dollar-cost-averaging) strategy manager


## Events
### StrategyCreated
Emitted when a new DCA strategy is created


```solidity
event StrategyCreated(uint256 indexed strategyId, IDCAStrategyManager.StrategyConfig config);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The identifier of the newly created strategy|
|`config`|`IDCAStrategyManager.StrategyConfig`|The configuration of the created strategy|

### StrategyEdited
Emitted when an existing DCA strategy's configuration is edited


```solidity
event StrategyEdited(uint256 indexed strategyId, IDCAStrategyManager.StrategyConfig config);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The identifier of the edited strategy|
|`config`|`IDCAStrategyManager.StrategyConfig`|The updated configuration of the strategy|

### StrategyPaused
Emitted when a DCA strategy is paused


```solidity
event StrategyPaused(uint256 indexed strategyId, uint256 nextTriggerAt);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The identifier of the paused strategy|
|`nextTriggerAt`|`uint256`|The timestamp at which the strategy would next trigger|

### StrategyResumed
Emitted when a paused DCA strategy is resumed


```solidity
event StrategyResumed(uint256 indexed strategyId, uint256 nextTriggerAt);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The identifier of the resumed strategy|
|`nextTriggerAt`|`uint256`|The updated timestamp at which the strategy will next trigger|

### StrategyCancelled
Emitted when a DCA strategy is cancelled


```solidity
event StrategyCancelled(uint256 indexed strategyId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The identifier of the cancelled strategy|

### StrategyCompleted
Emitted when a DCA strategy has completed


```solidity
event StrategyCompleted(uint256 indexed strategyId, bytes32 reason);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The identifier of the completed strategy|
|`reason`|`bytes32`|An encoded reason describing why the strategy completed|

### ExecutionCompleted
Emitted after each successful DCA execution.


```solidity
event ExecutionCompleted(
    uint256 indexed strategyId,
    uint256 tradesExecuted,
    uint256 inShares,
    uint256 outShares,
    uint256 inAssets,
    uint256 outAssets,
    uint256 nextTriggerAt
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The strategy that executed.|
|`tradesExecuted`|`uint256`|Post-increment trade counter (1-based).|
|`inShares`|`uint256`|Source-vault shares pulled from the owner (config.tradeAmount).|
|`outShares`|`uint256`|Target-vault shares delivered to the owner.|
|`inAssets`|`uint256`|Underlying in-asset amount represented by `inShares` at the moment of the trade (`sourceVault.convertToAssets(inShares)`).|
|`outAssets`|`uint256`|Underlying out-asset amount represented by `outShares` at the moment of the trade (`targetVault.convertToAssets(outShares)`).|
|`nextTriggerAt`|`uint256`|Updated `_strategyStates[strategyId].nextTriggerAt`.|
